study: v30 compatibility revalidation and disjoint whole-memory confirmation
registration: Before v30 execution or model calls. v29 seed42 guard results in both spaces and the registered proposal-only carryover diagnosis have been observed. v29 later seeds and the v27 common test remain ongoing. This is an exploratory development intervention on reused development data.
hypothesis: Old rule memory can become incompatible after the shared predictor/calibration changes, and individually beneficial adaptive witness edits may fail to transfer. Test whether revalidating old memory and confirming the entire new memory on separate patients improve the evolving agent beyond matched greedy and shuffled-evidence controls.
source_gate: Use a v29 seed only after its completed independent model/program audit passes. Reuse that seed's immutable original base/fold weights, cross-fitted fitting-patient probabilities, calibrated thresholds and fit/witness memberships with SHA256 locks. Do not fit another predictor, change source files, recalibrate thresholds or access test patients.
patient_roles: Keep v29 permanent fit/witness separation and five disjoint witness batches. Within each round, hash-sort that batch's unique patients using v30|seed|round|witness-split|patient and split floor(N/2) into edit group A and the remainder into confirmation group B. All visits of a patient stay together. A and B are disjoint from every fit/candidate patient and each other, and never reappear in another round.
compatibility_C: Before proposing edits, score the prior retained memory and empty memory under the same current policy/calibration on fitting-patient cross-fit predictions and group A. Whole-memory support requires at least3 affected patients, F1 gain >1e-12 and Jaccard gain >=-1e-12 on BOTH groups. C=1 starts from old memory only if both checks pass, otherwise empty memory. C=0 starts from the old memory regardless. Record shadow checks in both conditions; no individual rule is selected by these checks.
editing: Starting from the compatibility decision, independently generate that arm's current error evidence and new trajectory using the frozen v29 grammar/context/support implementation. Greedy enumerates its supported candidates and selects at most4. Own/shuffled language agents synthesize up to4 edits. Actual cross-fit induction support/gain filtering and sequential group-A F1/Jaccard verification are identical across every C/P condition. All methods use A only for these edits. Invalid or unsupported programs consume budget; no extra search retry.
confirmation_P: After all group-A edit decisions, compare the entire candidate memory against empty memory using group B exactly once. Require >=3 affected patients, F1 gain >1e-12 and Jaccard gain >=-1e-12. P=1 retains the candidate only when this check passes; otherwise it outputs empty memory for the current policy. P=0 retains the candidate regardless. Record the same shadow check in P=0 without changing its output. B labels never enter feature contexts, model calls, individual edit decisions or proposal ranking. Passing/failing B can influence the next round only through retained memory; this is adaptive training validation, not untouched confirmation.
matched_budget: Every condition computes the same old-memory cross-fit/A checks, up to4 group-A edit checks and one group-B whole-memory check. Gating changes how checks affect state, not data available to a method. Context search, checks, logical model calls and unique request hashes are recorded. Identical seed/round/method/payload calls across C/P variants share an exact response to reduce irrelevant generation noise; divergent states receive new prompts. Greedy and language compute differ and no equal-FLOP claim is made.
comparability: Unlike v29, even C0P0 uses only half of each fresh witness batch for editing; do not describe its cross-study difference as a pure gate effect. The registered 2x2 comparisons within v30 share exactly that half-split. Shuffled evidence changes numeric gains/support but retains actual feature/focus-drug selection. C and P are fixed engineering policies; only executable rule memory is agent-generated.
selection: After each raw round, proposal patient Jaccard selects the best round per arm, earliest tie. Retain all raw states, old-memory checks, candidate edits, rejections, confirmation outcomes and hashes. Only after all5 rounds freeze, score selected states on the same467-patient/1231-visit report-only guard. No guard/test score changes an edit or selects a condition.
endpoints: Patient F1/Jaccard, micro F1, size/empty rates and DDI-source coverage; raw round curves; retained rules/conjunctions; compatibility resets and confirmation resets; accepted/rejected program edits. Within each C/P condition compare own against greedy and shuffled. Within each method compare C and P main effects and interaction, both raw final-round and proposal-selected guard scores. Show all conditions, three-seed means/SD and descriptive paired patient intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted or universal superiority claim.
audit: Independent scalar set scoring and rule execution reconstruct every compatibility/edit/confirmation decision, induction effect and selected output. Revalidate source-model audit hashes and membership splits. Original v29 model refits are reused as provenance evidence, not claimed as new v30 fits. Publish only audited scores.
privacy: Only supported aggregate contexts reach the API. Records, patient identities, predictions and fitted weights remain local. Public outputs are code, aggregate results, hashes and validated rule predicates. No dose generation, clinical deployment or test inference.
